jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Overview At Entropy AI, we're building intelligence and agentic workflow infrastructure for financial services. Our systems help enterprises automate and improve real\-world journeys across acquisition, qualification, onboarding, renewals, customer service, collections, and assisted decisioning. As an AI Engineer at Entropy AI, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve production\-grade AI agents embedded inside enterprise workflows. This is not a prompt\-only role. You will own both the AI behaviour and the software systems around it: orchestration, APIs, state, latency, reliability, evaluation, observability, security, and measurable business outcomes. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and business teams to convert complex BFSI workflows into dependable AI systems that can listen, reason, call tools, complete tasks, escalate safely, and operate reliably in production. Key Responsibilities Build real\-time voice agents with robust turn\-taking, interruption handling, streaming, tool execution, escalation, and multilingual support. Design embedded AI agents for acquisition, onboarding, qualification, servicing, renewals, retention, and operations workflows. Develop orchestration and state\-management layers that reliably execute multi\-step workflows across internal and third\-party systems. Integrate LLMs, speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, telephony systems, APIs, databases, CRMs, queues, vector stores, and internal services. Build evaluation frameworks covering task completion, tool accuracy, hallucination, policy adherence, latency, containment, transfer quality, and cost. Implement observability using structured logs, traces, conversation analytics, alerting, and failure\-replay mechanisms. Optimise model selection, prompts, caching, retrieval, concurrency, and fallbacks for quality, speed, reliability, and unit economics. Partner with product, business, and customer teams to convert ambiguous workflows into production specifications and measurable acceptance criteria. Own engineering quality through clean code, automated tests, code reviews, deployment pipelines, runbooks, and incident learning. Document architecture, failure modes, evaluation methodology, and deployment processes so systems can scale beyond the original builder.

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Position Title**: AI/ML Engineer

**Years of Experience**: 2 years

**Work Model**: Work From Office

**Location**: Bhopal (M.P.)

**About Us**: At “IZI”, we are revolutionizing the world of consumer drones with cutting\-edge technology, innovative design, and a passion for excellence. we're on a mission to shake up the Indian tech scene by becoming the ultimate destination for cutting\-edge gadgets that are both cool and affordable. We're talking premium features without the premium price tag.

**Our vision**? To be the catalyst for epic experiences fueled by technology. We want to empower the user to conquer adventures and turn everyday moments into something extraordinary. But what truly sets IZI apart is our people. We are a team of dreamers, innovators, and trailblazers dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible. We believe in fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning, where every team member has the opportunity to grow and make a significant impact.

Join us, and you'll be part of a dynamic, forward\-thinking company that's shaping the future of technology and making a real difference in the world. If you're passionate about drones, technology, and innovation, IZI is the place for you. Together, let's take flight and soar to new horizons!

**What are we looking for**: We are seeking a mid\-level AI/ML Engineer to join our Technical Team. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and optimizing machine learning models specifically designed for drone platforms and aerospace applications. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of computer vision, edge computing, and avionics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 Develop and maintain software using Python, C, C\+\+, and Embedded C\+\+

 Model Development: Design and train ML models for object detection, obstacle avoidance, path planning, and autonomous navigation.

 Edge Deployment: Optimize models for real\-time inference on hardware\-constrained environments (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, or custom flight controllers).

 Data Pipeline Management: Build and maintain pipelines for processing aerial imagery and sensor data (LiDAR, RGB, Thermal).

 Avionics Integration: Work closely with the hardware/avionics team to integrate AI algorithms with flight control systems and telemetry protocols.

 Performance Monitoring: Define and track KPIs for model accuracy and reliability in diverse environmental conditions (low light, high wind, etc.)

**Technical Skills Required**

 Strong proficiency in Python, C, C\+\+, and Embedded C\+\+

 Core AI/ML: Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

 Computer Vision: Experience with OpenCV and architectures like YOLO, SSD, or Transformers for spatial analysis.

 Edge Computing: Familiarity with TensorRT, ONNX, or OpenVINO for model quantization and optimization.

 Aerospace Knowledge: Familiarity with UAV communication protocols (MavLink, ROS/ROS2\) and flight stacks (PX4, ArduPilot).

 Mathematics: Solid foundation in linear algebra, calculus, and 3D geometry for coordinate transformations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 Experience with Sensor Fusion (combining IMU, GPS, and Vision data).

 Background in Aerospace Avionics or flight simulation environments (Gazebo, AirSim).

 Understanding of embedded C/C\+\+ for low\-level system optimization.
